findings.claim: After loading only the current hosts' unexpired selectedSlots, the new deleteMany removes every other row for the same event type whose id is not in that filtered result set. Because the preceding findMany is restricted to `userId: { in: users.map(...) }` and `releaseAt > now`, this cleanup will also delete active reservations belonging to other users not in `users`, and even all expired rows for the event type, on every schedule lookup. That breaks reservation isolation and can make concurrent viewers lose their held slots unexpectedly.
findings.title: Selected-slot cleanup deletes other users' active reservations
